title: Sleepy sloth
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- branch -->
  <rect x='5' y='70' width='90' height='9' rx='4' fill='#8b5a2b'/>
  <rect x='5' y='70' width='90' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#b07a45'/>
  <!-- sloth body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='26' ry='20' fill='#a98560'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='20' ry='15' fill='#c9a87c'/>
  <!-- hanging arms -->
  <path d='M28 48 Q22 40 24 30 Q25 24 30 24' stroke='#8c6a48' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M72 48 Q78 40 76 30 Q75 24 70 24' stroke='#8c6a48' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- branch grip fingers -->
  <path d='M30 24 Q28 18 32 16' stroke='#6f5136' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M70 24 Q72 18 68 16' stroke='#6f5136' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='19' ry='17' fill='#c9a87c'/>
  <!-- face mask -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='45' rx='14' ry='12' fill='#e3cba5'/>
  <!-- sleepy eyes -->
  <path d='M41 43 Q44 47 47 43' stroke='#6b4e33' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M53 43 Q56 47 59 43' stroke='#6b4e33' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='49' rx='3' ry='2.2' fill='#5a4029'/>
  <!-- sleepy mouth -->
  <path d='M46 53 Q50 55 54 53' stroke='#7a5b3d' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='36' r='4' fill='#8c6a48'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='36' r='4' fill='#8c6a48'/>
  <!-- zzz -->
  <path d='M74 30 h6 l-6 6 h6' stroke='#9fe6ff' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M82 22 h5 l-5 5 h5' stroke='#9fe6ff' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- legs resting on branch -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='68' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#8c6a48'/>
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='68' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#8c6a48'/>
</svg>
